name: Video2MR
description: Generating Mixed Reality 3D Instructions from 2D Videos
title: Video2MR: Automatically Generating Mixed Reality 3D Instructions by Augmenting Extracted Motion from 2D Videos
booktitle: Proceedings of the 30th International Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces

conference.name: IUI 2025
conference.fullname: The ACM International Conference on Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI 2025)

bodyContent:
# Abstract

Video2MR automatically transforms 2D instructional videos into mixed-reality 3D sports and exercise guidance. It extracts motion into an avatar and augments that motion with posture comparison, trajectory visualization, time manipulation, and spatial repositioning.
